rationale: The safe-host baseline is phase_median_24 because it has the lowest historical hindcast sRMSE (0.3250275083617539 versus 0.5194760599927373), with no tie requiring sMAE. The supplied growth evidence qualitatively challenges stable same-hour medians, but it provides no numeric magnitude applicable to the forecast samples and therefore cannot validate the executed flat robust_weekly_drift trajectory. The maintenance, calibration, interference, and cooling evidence either establishes recovery before the relevant periods or concerns other targets, so it does not support an override. No verified evidence-to-assumption record specifically supports the alternative candidate's numeric trajectory strongly enough to overcome the hindcast result.
